verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS and self-hostable data platform like Airweave, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection or any opt-out control. Local self-hosting is a deployment option, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
